reading_log.notes: Read formal identity, introduction, complete related-work scope, CSP setup, and separate iterative model examples.
Read input/value/position/selected-set encodings, attention, Gumbel outputs, differentiable constraint table and iterative deployment.
Read all four task protocols, baseline tables, subset/position ablations, explicit fixed-constraint/SAT limitation and conclusion.
Read acknowledgments and all bibliography entries, matching internal catalogue titles/authors individually.
Read all numerical penalty examples, full CP formulations, graph generator selection and nurse ID/OOD configurations (printed identically).
Read all hyperparameter/Gumbel-temperature/multistart/additional classical baseline/penalty and direct-SGD appendices D–I.

Read every author-linked slide, then rendered/visually checked all14 including figure-only slides2/4/5/9/12/13 and the final paper link; same ICML identity and method/results, no separate new scientific experiment.
Read full author-linked poster and rendered full page, checking constraint diagrams/model/results and paper/code links.

Coverage via already fully read formal pages2–19, each full text and RGB rendered pixel exactly equal; file and per-page text/pixel hashes plus1:1 mapping in qr-version-page-equivalence.json. Not an independent second reading.

claims.statement: Single-step self-supervised Transformer refines complete CSP candidates through categorical/absolute/relative/subset encodings and constraint penalties.
One-step random assignment training/iterative discrete refinement; task-specific models and selected subsets; soft zero penalties are not general argmax feasibility certificates.
Positive Sudoku/coloring transfer and MaxCut scaling qualified by ORTools/ANYCSP negatives, simple nurse task and identical printed ID/OOD parameters; Gumbel/multistart not uniformly dominant.
Specialist improvement: separately trained task/color-count models edit complete candidates; common framework not demonstrated shared cross-native checkpoint.

Fixed implicit constraint structure cannot encode arbitrary parametric SAT clauses; more iterations not guaranteed termination/monotone feasibility, nurse OOD not established by identical printed settings.
